description: AM35 mouse light mode is switch/type/speed. Getter rest offsets are enabled@13, mode@14, speed@15 after the Host strips only Report ID; setter B3 30 writes enabled/mode/speed at request offsets 6/7/8. Mode is limited to 0..2 and speed to the official UI values 0..4. Source: AM Master macOS 1.3.8. Package SHA-256: b5824f7cc76dfc3b8ec98f56ebd0ab65491b7353b26bf2bb83647f3150ee21e8. Reverse evidence: AM_Master_1.3.8_reverse_core/disassembly/AM35_audit_targets.dis/FunctionArea.get_light_set and AM_Master_1.3.8_reverse_core/disassembly/AM35_light_mode_write.dis/FunctionArea.save_light_set.
